defined_before_label_inspection: No. This retrospective acquisition window was selected after reviewing 2024 perimeters; results are exploratory and not a preregistered model test.
revision_reason: The first available Full Disk scan can start 10-12 minutes after the UTC hour (observed 11:10:22 UTC on 2024-01-08). Sampling window widened uniformly to 12 minutes before label extraction; no fire labels or model results were used.
purpose: Retrospective event-coincidence audit against GlobFire burned perimeters; not ignition prediction or route-safety validation.
source: NOAA GOES-16 ABI-L2-FDCF Full Disk, original public NetCDF, one scan per UTC hour
sampling: First scan starting within the first twelve minutes of every UTC hour; fixed raster offsets at the eight existing Argentine catalog sectors; no selection using labels
country: IGN/Georef province polygons; exclude one native raster pixel at international borders
availability: Maximum of NetCDF date_created, S3 listing LastModified and original HTTP Last-Modified; conservative proxy, not proof of first publication
target: GOES-16 high-quality active-fire detections sampled near fixed Argentine trekking-sector centers; compare with separate-sensor GlobFire perimeters using the frozen spatial/date rule.
geographic_holdout_regions: Bosque Tallado desde la plataforma del Piltriquitron
geographic_test_period: Same dates as temporal test; all prior observations from these regions excluded from fitting, calibration and selection
calibration: Unweighted sigmoid calibration on a separate chronological block, before model/horizon selection
selection: On validation only: threshold maximizes recall subject to precision >= 0.80. Eligible candidates must satisfy project targets, beat prevalence Brier and baseline AP. Choose longest eligible horizon, then highest AP. Confirm this single selection on temporal and geographic tests; never back off to a shorter horizon after viewing test scores

project_targets.status: Exploratory project criteria, not a scientific consensus or a guarantee; operational use requires additional review

uncertainty: Cluster bootstrap by region and UTC target day; repeated pixel/scans are not independent fires; inter-day correlation and shared satellite-label errors remain limitations
unseen_detection_subset: All four available historical labels are zero; evaluate separately. Does not prove physical ignition: gaps, sensor limits and older undetected fire remain possible

events.nearest_route_sector: Cerro Ventana - Hueco de la Ventana

event_selection.intent: Acquire only periods covering the selected perimeter episodes and their date uncertainty margins.
